name: LanQin Email (Self-Hosted)
free_limit: GPL-3.0-only self-hosted mail server and webmail software; no vendor-hosted mailbox or sending quota included. Operator supplies infrastructure and sets mailbox/send limits.
watch_out: Requires Docker, own server/domain, DNS MX/SPF/DKIM/DMARC, TLS, available SMTP ports and mail deliverability setup; VPS and storage may cost money. GPL-3.0 obligations apply to redistribution/modifications. Production security configuration required.
